title: ICE’s New Detention Center Contracts Declare State Laws ‘Shall Not Apply’
summary: The new terms were published earlier this month, a day after a federal judge ruled that a contract cannot override state law and ordered ICE’s largest Pacific Northwest detention center opened to Washington health officials.
